Señor, I know that market better than it knows itself. Thirty-two is wishful thinking; the print run does not support it. My figure remains 25 P, and it is a fair one. Shall we conclude?

Señor, forty-four belongs in a dream, not in my album. I know exactly what this card is worth. Twenty-seven pesetas — offered with respect, and that is a generous page for Salamanca. Shall we close it at last?

Cuarenta y dos, cincuenta, da igual. Trece. Mercado de la Paz, ese precio. No se mueve. Paga o sigue andando.

Thirty is still a dream, señor. But I am not unkind — I shall stretch to 27 P, and not a peseta beyond. A clean copy deserves that much. Do we conclude?

Señor, thirty-eight would rob my evening of its peace. Twenty-nine pesetas — each step I take toward you is small but sincere. Let the Mercado de la Paz sleep in my album tonight. ¿Cerramos?
Forty-one, still? Querido, we are walking in circles down the Paseo. My figure has not moved: twenty-six pesetas, and the little Guantería rests safely in my album tonight. Take it, or keep her.
